title: OrgAnchor Signature v2
description: Detached signatures over the RFC8785-JCS domain-separated OrgAnchorSigningInput v2 object containing authority_hash, key_id, algorithm, signed_at, and the complete payload.
$comment: Runtime verification must check unique key IDs, authority_hash against the supplied authority, hash.value against the canonical payload, each signature over its domain-separated input, and the authority's complete-holder threshold. signed_at is authenticated metadata, not independent publication-time evidence.

value.description: SHA-256 of the canonical payload, not a digest of the signing-input wrapper.

signatures.description: Individual key signatures. This array may be incomplete while signatures are collected; its length is not a holder threshold count.
